headword: {電気料金|でんきりょうきん}

definitions.explanation: The fee charged for electricity consumption. Refers to both the amount owed and the billing statement from the power company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{電気料金|でんきりょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This month's electricity bill is high.

examples.japanese: ⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧すぎて{電気料金|でんきりょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{跳|は}ね{上|あ}がった→跳ね上がる：04615_haneagaru⟧。
examples.english: The electricity bill shot up from overusing the air conditioner.

examples.japanese: {電気料金|でんきりょうきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えている→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: Electricity price increases are having a major impact on household budgets.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧ (electricity) and ⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧ (fee, charge). This is the standard term for electricity costs in everyday conversation and official billing. In casual speech, ⟦{電気代|でんきだい}→電気代：09543_denkidai⟧ is more common and carries the same meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電気料金|でんきりょうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay the electricity bill
- {電気料金|でんきりょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: electricity charges go up
- {電気料金|でんきりょうきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{明細|めいさい}→明細：06448_meisai⟧: electricity bill statement
- {電気料金|でんきりょうきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧: electricity rate increase

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{電気代|でんきだい}→電気代：09543_denkidai⟧: electricity cost — more casual, used in everyday conversation
- ⟦{水道料金|すいどうりょうきん}→水道料金：22703_suidouryoukin⟧: water bill — same structure for water utility charges
- ⟦{ガス料金|がすりょうきん}→ガス料金：28952_gasuryoukin⟧: gas bill — same structure for gas utility charges
- ⟦{光熱費|こうねつひ}→光熱費：08244_kounetsuhi⟧: utility costs — collective term for electricity, gas, and water
